heading: INT. NIGHT MARKET - FISHMONGER'S STALL - NIGHT

units.text: INT. NIGHT MARKET - FISHMONGER'S STALL - NIGHT
Crushed ice, silver fish, a hanging bulb.
Steam from a noodle cart next door.
DOLORES MACIAS (50s, stall owner, rubber apron) guts a mackerel without looking at it.
Her son KWAME (20s, quiet, gloves too big) stacks crates.
At the end of the counter, STANISLAV (60s, camel coat, a folded newspaper) waits with his hands behind him.
PEACHES (30s, bright jacket, gum) lounges against the neighbor's cart.
ITO (40s, thin, glasses) browses the tuna with the patience of a man who never buys.
Two kilos?
units.name: DOLORES

units.text: One will do.
units.name: STANISLAV

units.text: She weighs it.
Wraps it.
Slides it across with a hand that stays on the paper a second too long.
Your boy's grown.
units.name: STANISLAV

units.text: He eats.
units.name: DOLORES

units.text: Mama, the ice.
units.name: KWAME

units.text: Then go get the ice.
units.name: DOLORES

units.text: Kwame leaves.
Peaches pushes off the cart, drifts closer, and studies a flounder as if she's going to marry it.
Fresh?
units.name: PEACHES

units.text: Today.
units.name: DOLORES

units.text: Today, today, or today?
units.name: PEACHES

units.text: Today.
units.name: DOLORES

units.text: Ito picks up a tuna steak and sets it down.
Stanislav unfolds the newspaper and sets it on the counter.
A small brown envelope lies inside it.
Dolores glances at the envelope, then at the flounder, then at the steam.
That one's not for sale.
units.name: DOLORES

units.text: It is for you.
units.name: STANISLAV

units.text: Then take it back.
units.name: DOLORES

units.text: Stanislav lifts the newspaper and folds it again, with the envelope inside, and tucks it under his arm.
He nods to her and walks away.
Peaches pays for the flounder with exact change.
Ito leaves without buying anything.
Dolores wipes her knife on her apron.
Kwame returns with a bucket of ice and pours it over the mackerel.
Who was that?
units.name: KWAME

units.text: A customer.
units.name: DOLORES
